backend/main.mo: Defines the main backend actor with access control, blob storage, and data models for inventory, sales, customers, suppliers, closures, and related state maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a frontend inventory validation feature to involved files, components, and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries of all frontend files describing their purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS config defining light and dark theme variables and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document mounting the frontend app and loading the main TypeScript entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the TanStack Router with all ERP module routes wrapped in the AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/customers/Overdu: Component displaying overdue credit alerts in inline or full alert variants with localization.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Invent: Create/edit inventory item dialog with client-side validation, image handling, and backend integration.
frontend/src/components/LargeButton.tsx: Large-sized button wrapper around the shadcn Button component with consistent sizing classes.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main application layout with navigation, global search, and CSV export functionality using various dataset serializers.
frontend/src/components/search/GlobalSea: Implements a modal product search with debounced queries, keyboard shortcut activation, and navigation on product selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating related queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides a hook that returns a debounced version of a value after a specified delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity, login, logout, and status via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for CRUD operations and lookups on inventory, customers, cashbox, exchange rates, suppliers, and closures via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures TailwindCSS base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes with design tokens.
frontend/src/lib/csvExport.ts: Provides CSV creation and downloading utilities including value escaping and array-to-CSV formatting.
frontend/src/lib/currency.ts: Offers currency formatting and conversion helpers for USD, VES, and COP, including multi-currency display.
frontend/src/lib/datasetSerializers.ts: Provides CSV serialization helpers for inventory, customers, cashbox entries, and exchange rates, plus header arrays for each dataset.
frontend/src/lib/errorMessage.ts: Extracts human‑readable messages from various error types, including IC agent error patterns.
frontend/src/lib/fileToBytes.ts: Converts File objects to byte arrays and creates image URLs from byte data.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Defines centralized Spanish translation strings and a lookup type for UI text.
frontend/src/lib/inventoryPricing.ts: Calculates sell price from cost and margin and derives margin percentage from cost and price.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides class name merging utility and a simple timestamp‑based ID generator.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/CashboxPage.tsx: Renders cashbox entries, totals, filters, and a form to add new entries.
frontend/src/pages/ClosuresPage.tsx: Displays cashbox closures and allows creating a new closure using totals and entries.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerDetailPage.ts: Shows customer details, debt, and overdue sales with navigation and alert handling.
frontend/src/pages/CustomersPage.tsx: Displays customer list, overdue alerts, and a modal form to add new customers using query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Shows KPIs, alerts, and analytics including stock, debt, overdue payments, top items, searches, and profit intervals.
frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx: Manages inventory listing with category filtering, low-stock alerts, and a form for adding or editing items.
frontend/src/pages/RatesPage.tsx: Displays latest exchange rates and provides a form to add new USD-to-VES/COP rate entries.
frontend/src/pages/SalesPage.tsx: Handles product search, cart management, pricing modes, and completing sales with immediate or credit payment.
frontend/src/pages/SupplierDetailPage.ts: Shows detailed information about a supplier with navigation support and fallback when not found.
frontend/src/pages/SuppliersPage.tsx: React page that lists suppliers, shows loading and empty states, and provides a dialog form to create new suppliers via mutations.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based parameter cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, custom colors, typography, container settings, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project state file describing issues, feature requests, and metadata for fixing product creation authorization and validation.
